Usage: codex exec [OPTIONS] [PROMPT]
Arguments:
  [PROMPT]
          Initial instructions for the agent. If `-` is used, instructions are read from stdin.
Options:
  --output-schema <FILE>
  --output-last-message <FILE>
  --sandbox <SANDBOX_MODE>
          [possible values: workspace-write, danger-full-access]
  --ignore-user-config
  --cd <DIR>
